retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait layered over a collage of urban scenes, framed by torn paper edges and topped with bold, wide-set red display type.
triggerTerms: torn paper collage hip hop cover
monochrome portrait with red bold text

recipe.visualDefinition: A central black-and-white close-up portrait of a man holding a large stack of currency to his ear, adorned with diamond jewelry. The background is a desaturated collage of smaller urban and personal photos. The entire composition is sandwiched between two horizontal white torn-paper textures at the top and bottom. Bold red sans-serif text sits atop the upper torn edge.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast monochrome subject against a lower-contrast collage background
Vibrant red typography providing the sole color pop against a grayscale palette
Rough, organic torn paper edges framing a structured photographic composition
Juxtaposition of luxury items (jewelry, cash) with gritty, textured paper effects
coreInvariants: Horizontal torn paper borders at top and bottom
Monochrome photographic treatment for all imagery
Single-color accent (Red) for primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale close-up portrait occupying the central 70% of the frame, slightly offset to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The hand holding the currency stack, centered and detailed with high-contrast highlights on jewelry.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold red text, move down to the subject's face, follow the hand and money stack, and rest on the bottom torn edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with collage elements, using the white torn paper as the only significant breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Grayscale (Black, White, and Mid-tones) for all photographic elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure White for the torn paper borders and background highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation in imagery with high value contrast; 100% saturation in the red text to create immediate focal priority.
paletteRestrictions: No colors other than Red, Black, and White

letterConstructionRules: Tight vertical height relative to width
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard heavy extended geometric forms

composition.position: Top right, overlapping the upper torn paper edge

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary brush-style or hand-drawn logo is paired with the clean geometric display type to add grit.
graphicDevices: Halftone or grain filters on background collage

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, square, heavy aesthetic of the display text.
Provides the necessary geometric weight and horizontal presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a black and white collage of urban photography. Overlay a large monochrome portrait of a man with jewelry and cash. Add horizontal white torn paper textures at the very top and bottom edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in a heavy, extended red sans-serif font across the top section, partially overlapping the upper torn paper edge.

verificationChecks: Is the text vibrant red and extended?
Are the top and bottom edges defined by a torn paper texture?
Is the main subject a high-contrast close-up?

adjustableVariables: Width of the torn paper borders
Tracking of the red display text
Contrast level of the monochrome portrait
mustRedesign: Specific faces from the background collage

mustAchieve: Sharp, high-contrast black and white tones
Realistic paper tear textures with visible fibers

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red text is the only color in the image.
Verify the torn paper edges look like physical paper overlays.
Check that the background collage does not distract from the main portrait.
Confirm the typography is perfectly horizontal and not slanted.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Urban Portrait + Background Photo Collage + Top/Bottom Torn Paper Borders + Bold Red Extended Sans-Serif Type.
